title: Local AI Server
author: samcripp
selftext: I'm very much considering picking up a [frame.work](http://frame.work) AI MAX 300+ Series with 128gbs for local Qwen. Curious if anyone has adventure into deploying a local AI server, how it went, and if they have any tips?

comments.author: UndeadBulwark_
comments.body: If you have 64GB of system RAM and a decent 16GB VRAM GPU, you can already run decently sized models, but if you want a lot of headroom for multiple models, then yes, the 128GB Strix Halo is worth it while costing a fraction of what Nvidia does. Note: I do not recommend running this on Windows; Vulkan and ROCm have better drivers on Linux.

replies.author: samcripp
replies.body: 100% a linux box. I was leaning more towards the [frame.work](http://frame.work) system but ill take a look at the Strix Halo.

replies.author: UndeadBulwark_
replies.body: Framework is Strix Halo my friend.

replies.author: samcripp
replies.body: Right, i get they are technically the same system, but I can get the [frame.work](http://frame.work) one for 1k cheaper!

replies.author: UndeadBulwark_
replies.body: Anyways look up Dwarfstar and Strata those are high end local models and just because you are getting a Strix Halo board doesnt mean you cant pair it with a GPU.

replies.author: samcripp
replies.body: as in not branded ones i see for 4,999$ but the ones branded [frame.work](http://frame.work) for 3,200

replies.author: samcripp
replies.body: I did consider doing some more typical. There is Tesla v100 with 32gbs of ram on ebay for 400$, but i just cant justified spending so much on ram for a build. so i figure an all in one is the way to go.

replies.author: UndeadBulwark_
replies.body: Get MI25s instead; they go for $70. There are also MI50 with 1050 GB/s.

replies.author: samcripp
replies.body: I dont use Cloude, everything I need I can probably accomplish with Qwen 27b lol.

replies.author: zenmatrix83
replies.body: be aware of the limitations, don't guess, I've used that model and it can do ok three.js "games" but there are major drawbacks. the ability to run trellis huyanan and other 3d 2d and video models locally on its own is worth it though

replies.author: samcripp
replies.body: i am very aware of the limitations

comments.author: Evening_Till_3779
comments.body: For game dev I would absolutely not use local AI. It's a total waste of money, it's just not good enough, and the hardware is so expensive it would take basically two years of Claude Ultra to equal the same amount, which is a LOT of usage... even just use Claude for a year then re-evaluate local models at that time.

replies.author: samcripp
replies.body: My guy, I accomplish everything I need on a 20$ plan. I dont need access to anything Ultra.

replies.author: samcripp
replies.body: I don't even hit my quotas lol

replies.body: I do if I like to keep my stuff private, be able to never loose access, and manage my own files. There is more to owning a local server than jus the output of the AI running. Lots of other benefits too
